### Mildew and the Cost of Sin
Author: Kevin Gardner
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/mildew-and-cost-of-sin
Passage: Leviticus 14:33-53
Points:
- Leviticus provides essential background for understanding Jesus Christ, even within its difficult purity laws.
- God claiming responsibility for the household mildew demonstrates His comprehensive sovereignty and providence over all things.
- The regulations concerning contaminated houses served as a vivid object lesson on the destructive nature of sin.
- Rooting out uncleanness came at a high personal price, but having a holy God dwell among them was worth the cost.
- Christ fully paid the ultimate price for sin on the cross so that God now dwells with His redeemed people.
